profile.headline: Software Engineer 2
profile.summary: Full Stack Engineer. I have years of hands on experience in Javascript and Typescript for creating functionalities and building APIs.I have used React.js, Angular and Vue.js to create components and designs on the front end.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining front-end solutions using React.
- Reusable components, Interactive UI elements, API Integrations.
- Build and integrate dynamic data tables using Javascript, JQuery and React.
- Maintain internal APIs between client and internal systems.
- Developing back-end solutions with MySQL for database management.
- Leveraging AWS services, including S3, for secure file storage/transfer and EC2 for server
hosting.
- Independently migrated two production Hostek servers to AWS EC2. Configuring Nginx/
Lucee/Tomcat to improve scalability
- Manage and setup Docker Containers
- Serve as primary contact (POC) for technical integrations and ongoing support.
- Reviews and approved pull requests from colleagues to ensure code quality and
adherence to best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · TypeScript · Docker Products · MySQL · Nginx · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Github

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Update our internal RESTful API’s using Typescript, and Jest.
- Added features to display/filter data, design changes, and additional UI components with React.js.
- Participated alongside different teams for a 3 month project to create a workflow management tool
for collaborations between teams. Learned and incorporated Remix into the front-end.
- Maintained Postgres database with Prima.
- Earned AZ-900 Certificate and Managed/Monitored App Services and Azure Web Apps.
• Identified issues through NewRelic tools in production and development environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Jest · Prisma · Unit Testing · Docker Products · React.js · PostgreSQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrate data from third party insurers with Javascript to allow customers to receive quotes from more than one insurance companies.
- Integrated social media into the backend to allow insurers to create advertisements.
- Designed sections of various sites with Vue.js.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Updates and develops RESTful APIs using JavaScript and GraphQL for internal use.
- Designed Web Application using Node.js, React.js for the front end and Oracle as the database. 
- Developed modules that retrieve different datasets from Oracle utilizing the RESTful APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Oracle Database · Docker Products · React.js · REST APIs · Angular · Full-Stack Development · GraphQL · Swagger API

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
• Provided local/remote technical support, computer and tablet scheduling, deployment and maintenance.
• Curriculum troubleshooting, including Arduino, code debugging.
• Organized shipments for Electronics/Laptops/iPads between different locations across the US and Canada.

positions.title: Software Development Research Assistant
positions.description: Mesa Lab, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems and Automation, is a research lab that is part of the University Of California, Merced. I work under a graduate student and am given instruction to code various tasks to manipulate data using Java.

positions.title: Front Desk Representative
positions.description: I assist customers by taking reservation and checking customers in. I help customers with any questions they have and help them satisfy their needs. Responsible handling money transactions.

projects.title: Recip-Easy
projects.description: Mobile friendly web application that allows user to generate recipes from items they select in virtual fridge. Users can add items to fridge manually, scan a barcode, or use image recognition by taking a picture.
